# The Argyle Collection

> Private treaty sale of three certified Argyle pink diamonds from the Argyle
> Diamond Mine, East Kimberley, Western Australia. The mine closed in November
> 2020 and no new supply of Argyle pink diamonds exists.

This is a single-page site presenting the three stones to auction houses,
specialist dealers and vetted private buyers.

## What is offered

- Three Argyle pink diamonds, each certified by Argyle Pink Diamonds and
  accompanied by a GIA coloured diamond report and an independent valuation.
- Prices are on application only; no figures are published.
- The stones are held in secure vaulted storage in Australia and may be
  inspected by appointment through the vendor's representative.
- All documentation is verifiable directly with GIA and the Argyle Pink
  Diamonds registry.
